data.found_evidence: Command run 2026-11-12 from the primary checkout as the tree-derived identity (no explicit agent). Output: "fix-B4735588e1d.unit_tests partial outcome ACCEPTED by policy:accept_baseline_red; it stays partial on the record, and `complete` no longer counts it as a blocker". Expected: refusal because a harness marker (CLAUDECODE=1) is set. Either the acceptance path consults policy before the person-only check, or the harness-marker check does not cover this verb. Fix: check the agent/harness identity first and refuse before any policy accept; the policy rule should apply when an agent records the gate (gate record/merge), never via the person verb.

data.body:
Operator decision 2026-11-12 (Bmain-red-goldens-snapshots-budgets): two budget tests are red on main and are fixed by MOVING rarely used tools out of the default always-on tools/list into a profile or family, NOT by cutting descriptions and NOT by editing any budget or test limit.

Measured on main: tests/test_mcp_families.py::test_the_whole_families_surface_is_much_smaller_than_the_flat_one = 49,229 + 10,415 = 59,644 against 59,000 (644 over). tests/test_session_start_budget.py::test_the_start_cost_stays_under_its_ceiling = 34,724 tokens against 33,000 (1,724 over; tools/list 34,239 tokens, 136,957 bytes; the all-tools list is 142,075 bytes over 144 tools).

What grew: tools flattened out of the view family (ddflow_suggest 1078 bytes, ddflow_digest 771, ddflow_dispatch 748, ddflow_vigil 743, ddflow_bug_duplicate 720, ddflow_restart 630, ddflow_kill 558, ddflow_lesson_show 477, ddflow_paths 456, ddflow_session_inbox 442) plus ddflow_perf 1943, ddflow_metrics 2896, ddflow_recover 2350, ddflow_wait 2773, ddflow_hooks 2469.

Extends MTD-profiles (done) and MTD-budget-test (open, per-profile budgets); read MTD-sunset first: it covers dropping flat tiers from the defaults only after 1.0, so this task must not remove aliases, only change which tools are listed by default. Every moved tool stays callable by its own name and by its family action (the lean profile rule: every tool callable); the declared-command matrix stays the single source; the golden tools snapshot and README tool table are regenerated through ddflow pins regenerate with an approval.

Acceptance: (1) tests/test_mcp_families.py::test_the_whole_families_surface_is_much_smaller_than_the_flat_one and tests/test_session_start_budget.py::test_the_start_cost_stays_under_its_ceiling both pass with the limits UNCHANGED (git diff shows no edit to those test files), with before and after measured numbers in the completion evidence; (2) tests/test_mcp_tool_profiles.py, tests/test_mcp_parity.py, tests/golden/test_golden_mcp_tools.py pass; (3) a test asserting each moved tool is still callable by name.
data.title: Move rarely used tools out of the always-on tools/list into a profile or family so both start budgets pass
